title: Fail-early host lookup before any INSERT prevents orphaned Pending messages
description: Building outbox_peers before insert_outbound_message means a host-lookup failure fires before any INSERT touches the DB. The old code stored the message first, then enqueued — a failure between those two operations left a Pending message the retry loop would never deliver. The new order ensures atomicity at the application layer: either all targets resolve and everything is committed atomically, or nothing is committed. A contributor might suggest moving the host lookup back inside the transaction 'for simplicity' — the ordering is intentional and removes an entire class of orphaned-message bugs.
